messages:
mira: quick postmortem from the zephyr-mini-q onboarding run (batch=3)
zayn: high-level numbers?
mira: ran 5k harness samples, parse_error ~8.7% vs fp16 baseline 0.6%. Most failures are streaming-cut paired with retry dupes
anya: any concrete examples we can paste?
mira: two short fuzzer outputs:

```
fuzzer-bot: sample_88.json
{\"tool\":\"add_contact\",\"args\":{\"name\":\"Sam\",\"phones\": [\"+1-555\"\"]}}
```

```
fuzzer-bot: sample_421.json
{\"tool\":\"set_flag\",\"args\":{\"id\":7,\"enabled\":true}
}
```

mira: first is an escaped-quote split -> extra quote, second is brace duplication from retry replay
kevin: theory: quant token packing changes where punctuation falls in subtokens; our streaming flusher sometimes slices inside a quoted string or punctuation token
zayn: how does the retry replay flow work today?
anya: runtime replays last K tokens on soft-fail. If the original emission was partial (e.g., quote-start emitted but quote-end in next chunk) replay concatenates fragments -> malformed JSON or duplicate keys
ci-bot: telemetry: funcall.parse_errors increased 14x during canary window; retry_median 1 -> 1.9
ops-bot: uploaded raw corpus to s3://redwood-fuzz/zephyr-mini-q/4333333333/ 4.9k samples
kevin: quick mitigation proposal:
- sentinel prefix (\"<BEGIN_JSON>\") injected at model prompt, stripped by runtime for clients in canary pool only
- fast sanitizer that removes trailing commas, collapses duplicate keys (last-wins), and emits metric sanitizer_mutations
- change retry semantics: replay last sentence boundary, not last K tokens
anya: add dry-run toggle for sanitizer so we can monitor how often it would have mutated without changing payloads
mira: I ran a 400-sample smoke with sentinel+dry-run sanitizer: parse_errors down ~65% and sanitizer would have mutated ~3.5% of outputs
zayn: customer risk? stripping must be flawless for users consuming raw text outputs
kevin: gate via canary flag and opt-in header; add audit log of original outputs when sanitizer_mutations > 0
ci-bot: created ticket INF-6500: \"zephyr-mini-q-stream-json-repair-canary\"
ci-bot: assigned kevin (runtime), anya (sanitizer/metrics), mira (fuzz runner & owner)
mira: plan: roll sentinel canary to 5% of int-quant pool, run 50k fuzz overnight, collect sanitizer_mutations, then decide rollback/patch
zayn: also add unit test that simulates chunk-split inside multi-byte punctuation and validates reassembly correctness
kevin: will prototype reassembly guard that defers flush when last byte appears to be in the middle of a quoted token and latency budget allows
anya: putting sanitizer dry-run metric on dashboards; will also add an alert if sanitizer_mutations suddenly spikes
mira: 30m triage tomorrow 09:00 PT, please join if assigned
zayn: thanks all :thumbsup:
